posts.author: office-coordinator
posts.body:
The coffee fund is empty again. There was a note in the tin that said "IOU" and no name.

50 cents a cup. That sign has been on the machine since 1994.

posts.author: office-coordinator
posts.body: The tea comes out of the coffee fund too.

posts.author: branch-manager
posts.body:
Whoever had the van on Friday: it smells of fish. The van is a work vehicle, not a cold store.

Own up. Anonymously is fine, but I already know.

posts.author: service-contract-planner
posts.body: That was not fish. That was a trap from 3 Main Street.

posts.author: office-coordinator
posts.body:
The holiday list is on the notice board. Please write on it, do not paste over it.

Two people per week, not three, and the emergency desk stays staffed.

posts.author: office-assistant-2
posts.body: I would like the week when nobody calls.
